Changes in this revision

  • Logo raised 12 px for better visual balance with the wordmark weight
  • QR label changed from CONNECT to SCAN TO CONNECT for trade-show UX clarity
  • Footer URL changed from usrad.com / connect to usrad.com/connect (web-native)
  • Donna's card added — same design language, different name, title, and email
  • Donna's title locked as Co-Founder & Chief Member Advocate (aligned with member identity architecture)

Specifications

Dimensions
Standard US business card, 3.5" × 2" (88.9 × 50.8 mm)
Preview scale
Shown at 200 px/inch — actual printed card is the size of a standard card
QR code
Real, scannable — encodes https://usrad.com/connect with error correction level Q
Brand colors
Navy #0d2a5c, gold #cc9933, off-white paper #fdfcf8
Typography
Name in serif (Georgia in preview, refined editorial serif in print file). Everything else clean sans-serif.
Recommended stock
32 pt soft-touch or suede laminate, off-white, matte finish. Optional: navy edge paint.
Recommended printers
Moo Luxe, Jukebox Print, Elegante Press
